Title: Civil Drafter
Occupation: Civil Engineering Draftsperson (ANZSCO 312211)
Salary: $90K + Super
Hours: Full time

Trading Name: ARCOS Group
Employer: Arcos Unit Group Pty Ltd
Location: 177c Brisbane Road, Mooloolaba QLD 4557

We’re seeking an experienced Civil Designer/Drafter to join our Sunshine Coast team in a full-time role.

Working alongside a team of talented engineers and designers, you'll contribute to a diverse and active project pipeline.

Experience Required: Qualifications + min 1 year in a relevant role

Success in this position means delivering accurate and efficient drafting solutions that align with project and client expectations, while fostering working relationships with internal teams, clients, and authorities.

Applicants must have permanent working rights to work in Australia.

Some of the duties you will be required to perform include:

*Develop and deliver civil drafting documentation across land development and/or transport infrastructure projects
*Experienced in planning, preparing and managing civil drawing packages and using AutoCAD
*Experienced design capability in 12D (including Network Editor) or Civil3D
*Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to ensure technical accuracy and design efficiency
*Apply relevant Australian standards, local government requirements, and Austroads guidelines in design solutions
*Manage time effectively to handle multiple projects and deadlines
*Contribute to continuous improvement of drafting practices and project outcomes
*Assisting with the development of construction documents/specifications and construction phase queries


About Arcos Group

Arcos is a multi-disciplinary engineering consultancy delivering civil, geotechnical, and structural solutions across private, corporate, and government sectors. Operating across local and interstate markets, we’re known for our practical, high-quality approach and our commitment to achieving client outcomes.

Visa Sponsorship: Nomination for temporary work visa and/or Permanent Residency will be considered for eligible candidates.

result.description:
Blenners Transport Pty Ltd are currently looking to recruit experienced and qualified Airconditioning and Refrigeration Mechanics to join their team in Tully Qld 4854.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

- Inspection, maintenance, repairs, and installation of equipment according to requirements including units, mounting gear and piping.
- Perform repairs and routine maintenance duties on equipment and its components such as compressors, motors, condensers, evaporators, gas, refrigerant, etc.
- Run equipment to observe and test its operation and perform any required adjustments
- Perform repairs or adjustments on piping connections, valves, couplings and fittings by riveting, bolting, welding, brazing, and soldering applying hand and power tools
- Order replacement of equipment parts as required, perform repairs as ordered, and keep record of servicing on equipment
- Carry out minor electrical maintenance work, such as repair or replacement of fixtures, including wall switches and outlets, ballast, incandescent and fluorescent tubes and bulbs, fuses, sockets, etc., by applying the right tools
- Fill up units and systems with gas required fluid checking for leaks
- Perform related duties that may be and refrigerating equipment assigned

Skills and Abilities:

- Certificate III in Air-conditioning and Refrigeration trade
- At least 2 years of hands-on working experience in similar position
- Able to work in places where they are exposed to dust, fumes, noise, toxic materials, and high voltage equipment
- Capable of working in confined and hot spaces like roofs, crawl ways and attics
- Ability to perform physical activities such as climbing, bending, balancing, stooping, kneeling, squatting, crawling, reaching, crouching, push/pull objects, etc.
- Ability to work with manual or power tools and operate motorized vehicles
- Strong knowledge of the methods, practices, test instruments, tools, and materials typically applied in repairing and servicing various refrigeration and air conditioning systems, and other similar equipment
- Strong knowledge of the hazards involved in the occupation, and the safety precautions to take
- Strong knowledge of the repair characteristics and mechanical operation of various types of air conditioning

Salary range is $70,000-$85,000pa commensurate with experience

Fulltime Positions available


Applications open on 23rd July 2026 and closes on 23rd August 2026


If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
